text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent in the CRM.

**2. Accuracy depends on setup.** Noisy job sites and cross-talk hurt transcripts until we gave reps better mics and a quick pre-call checklist.

**3. Managers coached differently.** Searchable call summaries let leads spot patterns in objections instead of relying on ride-alongs alone.

**4. Trust came first.** Adoption jumped once we told customers upfront when calls were recorded.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed up room for it.

What's your team learning from AI pilots?

*(Scenario is synthetic; figures are illustrative.)*
